question: The activation energy of a reaction:

options.opa: It is not modified by the action of enzymes.
options.opb: It is the energy necessary to reach the state of transition.
options.opc: It is lower than the energy of the substrates.
options.opd: It is lower than the energy of the products.
options.ope: It is an average of the value of ΔG of the reaction.
